source: Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0, CC0 (License.txt). https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit . .glb as shipped (Models/GLTF format), materials are flat colours.
notes: Furniture convention (sockets furniture_*, hazard_*, dressing_*, decal_*, terminal_wall, power_switch, elevator_door): the wrapper origin is the centre of the piece's footprint on the floor, its long side runs along X and its front (the side a unit uses) faces +Z.

footprint is [x, z] in tiles. tier is light or heavy (the cover tiers of ROOM_THEMES_PLAN.md D.3), dressing (no cover of its own), clutter (under 0.35 m), wall (origin on the wall face at floor level, +Z into the room) or door (centred on the wall line like door_frame).

These sockets are not drawn yet: they wait for ROOM_THEMES_PLAN.md D.1 (obstacles get a kind) and D.6 (MapBuilder picks a piece per kind). tools/test_kit_coverage.gd holds every piece to its footprint and tier; tools/room_kit_gallery.gd renders them.

rooms lists the room types a dressing piece suits. tall marks a light piece that stands above light-cover height on purpose. Scale and offset were fitted to the footprint from each model's measured bounds.

pieces.tall: a bunk is two beds high; ROOM_THEMES_PLAN.md D.2 calls bunks light cover
